working_definition: Dm4 is a distal medullary wide-field amacrine interneuron of the adult optic lobe. Its soma lies in the anterior cell body rind of the medulla cortex; the main neurite extends into M6 then bends back to arborize at the M5/M6 boundary and in M3B with mixed morphology, covering approximately 21 columns with tiling and following column boundaries. It is glutamatergic (Davis et al., 2020), a secondary Notch OFF hemilineage neuron, and is named after the canonical morphological type established by Fischbach and Dittrich (1989).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Distal medullary wide-field amacrine neuron whose cell body is located in the anterior region of the cell body rind of the medulla. The main neurite extends into M6, and then turns back to arborize in the boundary between M5 and M6, and in M3B, with mixed morphology arborizations. The arbor varies in shape between cells, covering around 21 columns, but with these areas tiling. It is located in a central position in the column, surrounded by the terminal of photoreceptors R7 and R8, with the cell boundaries following the column boundaries. There are around 40 Dm4 neurons per hemisphere. They are glutamatergic (Davis et al., 2020).

justification: The cluster label 'Dm4' denotes the canonical optic-lobe cell type that FBbt records as 'distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm4' (FBbt:00003771). Every diagnostic feature aligns: soma in the anterior cell body rind of the medulla cortex, main neurite into M6 bending back to arborize at the M5/M6 boundary and in M3B, mixed morphology arborizations covering approximately 21 columns with tiling, central columnar position surrounded by R7/R8 terminals, approximately 40 cells per hemisphere, and glutamatergic neurotransmitter identity. The cluster class (N=neuron) and region (optic lobe medulla) are consistent. FBbt:00003771 is not obsolete and has no Dm4-specific subtype terms that would require further discrimination. The label match is direct and the definition correspondence is complete.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: An amacrine neuron that is intrinsic to the medulla, whose soma is located in the cortex of the medulla and that branches and arborizes in the distal medulla. These neurons project through the distal surface of the medulla, to form wide (sometimes very wide) terminal arborizations mainly or completely restricted to a single layer of the medulla.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm4 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hbn/Opa/Slp temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
